scripts.package:mac:dev: mkdir -p release && cd release && npx -y pake-cli http://localhost:5173 --name "BuildBlock Dev" --icon ../packaging/icon.png --identifier com.weilercavasotto.buildblock.dev --width 1280 --height 800 --wasm --disabled-web-shortcuts --app-version $npm_package_version
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cd release && npx -y pake-cli ../dist/index.html --use-local-file --name BuildBlock --icon ../packaging/icon.png --identifier com.weilercavasotto.buildblock --width 1280 --height 800 --wasm --disabled-web-shortcuts --app-version $npm_package_version
scripts.site:sync: cp public/logo-stacked.svg public/favicon.svg public/favicon.ico public/apple-touch-icon.png site/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/orbitron/files/orbitron-latin-wght-normal.woff2 site/fonts/
scripts.deploy:site: npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy site --project-name buildblock-site --branch main
scripts.deploy:play: npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name buildblock-play --branch main
